Slide up to see your word.\nLet go and it hides itself.
You have no word. Listen, blend in and don\'t get caught.
You have no word. If you\'re voted out, guess the word to win.
Guess the civilians\' word to win the game.
Paste the link someone sent you (or the whole message). You can also share it straight to this app from the chat.
That isn\'t a word pack link (or it got cut off)
Scan it with the other phone\'s camera. The whole pack is inside the code: no internet or account needed.
The included packs can\'t be changed, but you can make a copy of your own and edit it as you like. The original stays available; you can untick it when picking the packs for a game.
One per line: word / similar / similar…
Similar words are optional and you can add several (Beach / Pool / Lake): the impostor gets one at random. Without them, they get another word from the pack.
Add a name and at least 3 words
Pass the phone around. Everyone sees the same secret word… except the impostors.
In turns, say one word or short phrase about it. Not too obvious, or the impostor will catch on.
Discuss and vote someone out. The app reveals what they were.
Civilians win by voting out every impostor. Impostors win if only one civilian is left. The Drifter can also win by guessing the word when voted out.
Free forever: every pack, no ads, no subscriptions, no tracking. Made with care by Jorge Lillo.
You\'ve played almost all of them: the oldest will come back. Add more packs or create your own.
All modes play the same way: everyone sees their word in secret, gives one clue per turn, and you vote someone out. What changes is who gets what.
Civilians get the word. The impostor gets a similar one (Beach vs. Pool) and isn\'t told they\'re the impostor: everyone sees the same screen.
Civilians: vote out every impostor. Impostors: last until only one civilian is left, without realising it at first.
If the others\' clues don\'t quite fit your word… maybe you\'re the impostor. The best mode once the group knows the game. From 3 players.
Civilians get the word. Impostors get nothing, not even the category, and know they\'re impostors.
The same: civilians vote them all out, impostors survive until one civilian is left.
Impostor: listen before you speak and give vague clues. Civilians: not too obvious or they\'ll catch on. Great for first games and kids. From 3 players.
Like Classic, plus one Drifter with no word who knows it. The Drifter never starts the round.
If the Drifter is voted out, they get one last guess at the word: get it right and they win alone. If not, the game goes on. If they survive until one civilian is left, they win with the impostors.
Civilians: careful with clues that give the word away. Drifter: pretend and piece it together from the clues. From 4 players.
About one game in three ignores the impostor count: there can be one, several… or everyone. Nobody knows how many there are, so trust no one.
In The Drifter and drawing mode, players without a word see which pack it comes from (never in Blind: there impostors get nothing). Turn it off for a harder game.
An optional countdown before each vote, so nobody drags it out. When time\'s up it beeps and you go straight to the vote.
The more of you, the better it gets
Let\'s play Who\'s lying? The impostor word game, free and with no ads: %1$s
One by one, say a word or short phrase about your secret word.
When you\'re ready, go to the vote.
Discuss it and decide together who goes.
Who do you think is lying?
Innocent… the liar is still among you.
Well spotted! But someone is still lying.
A civilian was voted out and only one is left.
Only one civilian is left: they got away with it!
They guessed the word when voted out.
No talking: draw the word together, one stroke each
%1$s starts. Pass the phone: add something each, no talking!
Our drawing of "%1$s" in Who\'s lying? %2$s

Instead of saying clues, you draw the word together on one canvas: pass the phone and each adds a stroke or a detail. Impostors get no word (just the category, if the hint is on and the mode isn\'t Blind) and have to bluff. Then vote as usual, and share the masterpiece at the end.

Every player on the winning side scores, even if voted out: civilians 5 points, impostors and the Drifter 15. Points add up over the match (10 rounds by default, change it in setup); the ranking shows after every round, and after the last one the winner is crowned.
Civilians win 5 points, impostors and the Drifter 15.
A Google form opens in your browser with this word and what you wrote, ready to send. Nothing else is shared.
We made this app for friends who just want to have a good time together: no ads, no fuss.
Zero profit motive: no ads, no purchases and none of your data.
Our two beta testers went as far as they could 😅, so you may find the odd bug. If you do, tell us: we\'ll be really grateful!
